data.body: RCA/evidence: the lag-free overlay was scoped-only, so unscoped reconcile passes still let stale JQL search snapshots feed the level-triggered inbound differ. Change 2965 generalizes the overlay to unscoped passes by selecting only ambiguous, confirmed, bound local rows where local still matches baseline while the raw search snapshot differs from baseline; it overlays primary-store GET scalars before differs/baseline advance. Review remediation narrowed the candidate scan to loaded local tickets, prefilters raw remote-vs-baseline equality before mapper work, falls back to the configured inbound mapper when ctx.runtime_backend is absent, and pins pending/malformed-local no-GET contracts. RED evidence: new unscoped stale-clobber and bounded-GET tests failed before the fix. Verification: focused overlay+wiring tests passed; full make verify PYTEST_WORKERS=2 with GIT_CONFIG_* unset passed. Gerrit 2965 merged with LLM-Review+1 and Verified+1.
